namespace PubAC12
inductive TreeTrace
  | root : TreeTrace
  | attachLeaf : TreeTrace → TreeTrace
def numVertices : TreeTrace → Nat
  | .root => 1
  | .attachLeaf t => numVertices t + 1
def numEdges : TreeTrace → Nat
  | .root => 0
  | .attachLeaf t => numEdges t + 1
theorem tree_vertices_eq_edges_add_one (t : TreeTrace) : numVertices t = numEdges t + 1 := by sorry
end PubAC12
